basic_details.job_title: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Clinical Psychologist, Psychiatric Social Worker Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER Thiruvananthapuram, MoE, Govt. of India) is filling three temporary posts in its Wellness Centre: two Psychiatric Social Worker (PSW) posts at Rs 35,000 and one Clinical Psychologist post at Rs 40,000. Each appointment is for one year, extendable based on satisfactory performance. Applications are open through a separate Google form for each post, and the last date is 10 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are sent through the Google form for the post applied for, on or before 10 December 2026. The notice gives these form addresses:

The application must be submitted along with documents of proof of educational qualification and experience. The email-id and mobile number of the candidate are mandatory in the application. Incomplete applications, and those not supported by the relevant documents, will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: If any information in the application is found incorrect or false at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the vacancy or vacancies advertised, without assigning reasons. The decision of the competent authority on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, screening criteria, equivalence of qualifications and mode of selection is final and binding. Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence will be treated as a disqualification.

One year, extendable based on satisfactory performance (temporary positions)

content_sections.heading: About IISER Thiruvananthapuram
content_sections.text: IISER Thiruvananthapuram is an institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, in Thiruvananthapuram. These posts are for the Wellness Centre at the Institute, which serves the Institute community: students, staff and their dependents.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 3 posts in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. The qualifications and experience in the notice are only the minimum. Holding them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the further selection process. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for the further selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience, when many applications are received. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master’s Degree in Psychiatric Social Work
Post graduate degree in clinical psychology; valid RCI registration; one-year post-qualification experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are temporary in nature. Each appointment is for one year, extendable based on satisfactory performance. The notice prints no allowance or HRA on top of the pay.

content_sections.heading: IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provides counselling service, helps people who struggle with mental health problems and helps them cope with their issues. Provides client care in consultation with other members of the mental health team (psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, etc.). Offers individual and group therapy sessions to patients. Conducts regular awareness training for supporting staff and the Institute community on mental health and mental hygiene. Maintains case records and prepares reports of each patient. Works in shifts, is available on all working days including Saturdays for the campus Institute community, and attends emergencies at any time. Does all other works assigned from time to time. Consults clients and identifies psychological, emotional or behavioural issues. Diagnoses psychological, emotional or behavioural disorders and administers programs of treatment. Develops and implements treatment plans and therapeutic processes. Takes care of emergencies (on-call basis). Works in shifts and on all working days including Saturdays. Works with student communities, staff and their dependents to improve psychological wellness and to address mental health issues. Helps students define goals, plan action, and gain insight. Treats psychological disorders using various psychological techniques; selects the treatment approach and plans frequency, intensity and duration of individual, group and family therapies. Provides crisis intervention in situations requiring immediate psychological treatment. Helps clients define goals and plan action to achieve personal, social, educational and vocational development and adjustment. Monitors client progress through regular meetings or sessions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are sent through the Google form for the post applied for, on or before 10 December 2026. The notice gives these form addresses: Clinical Psychologist: https://forms.gle/qBNoyuHbGKCs2La49 Psychiatric Social Worker: https://forms.gle/Y9JjF4PoYZkaaFjA8 The application must be submitted along with documents of proof of educational qualification and experience. The email-id and mobile number of the candidate are mandatory in the application. Incomplete applications, and those not supported by the relevant documents, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of candidates shortlisted for interview will be communicated by e-mail only, and no other written communication will be made. The notice does not give the interview date or mode. Shortlisted candidates must produce the original documents supporting their claims on educational qualification, proof of date of birth, experience and so on. These are verified prior to the selection process. Candidates who do not have the original documents as claimed will not be allowed to participate in the selection process. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If any information in the application is found incorrect or false at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the vacancy or vacancies advertised, without assigning reasons. The decision of the competent authority on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, screening criteria, equivalence of qualifications and mode of selection is final and binding. Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence will be treated as a disqualification.

rows.details: Notice of the Psychiatric Social Worker and Clinical Psychologist posts

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in IISER Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 2 Psychiatric Social Worker (PSW) posts and 1 Clinical Psychologist post, all in the Wellness Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Psychiatric Social Worker?
faq.answer: A Master’s Degree in Psychiatric Social Work is required. One year of relevant experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Clinical Psychologist?
faq.answer: A post graduate degree in clinical psychology, valid RCI registration and one-year post-qualification experience are required. Experience in handling adolescent cases is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 35,000/- for Psychiatric Social Worker and Rs 40,000 for Clinical Psychologist.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google form given in the notice for the post concerned, on or before 10 December 2026, with proof of educational qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q7. How are shortlisted candidates informed?
faq.answer: The list of candidates shortlisted for interview is communicated by e-mail only, so the email-id and mobile number are mandatory in the application.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are temporary in nature, with a duration of one year that is extendable based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Only citizens of India can apply, and they must meet the qualification and experience stated for the post.
